meta.title: Agency 1.0 or 'when form outweighed content'
meta.description: Classic (previous) video agencies were focused exclusively on the process. Briefings were held formally, dozens of edits were made, endless emails were written and sent. Finally, the final videos were delivered. Yes, they looked nice, sometimes even cool. But they did not solve any real business tasks.

chapter1.title: visual communication
chapter1.p1: Classic (previous) video agencies were focused exclusively on the process. Briefings were held formally, dozens of edits were made, endless emails were written and sent. Finally, the final videos were delivered. Yes, they looked nice, sometimes even cool. But they did not solve any real business tasks.
chapter1.p2:
In other words, video agencies 1.0:

1. Worked for the sake of process.
2. Had complicated paperwork.
3. Delivered visually attractive results but with little meaning.

In short, they worked more for themselves than for their business client. That’s the key difference.

chapter2.title: Agency 2.0: 'why fresh vision matters'
chapter2.p1:
Agency 2.0 organizes work not around video, but around the specific goals of the client. The unique approach is visible not only in creativity. At the same time, a new structure is offered, impressive numbers appear, and a strong effect is created.

The goal of Agency 2.0 is to build systematic and effective visual communication. To implement a holistic marketing strategy, the team creates storytelling, infographics, and video. This is a fundamentally new approach to the client.

A modern video marketing agency relies not just on good looks.

Here the focus is on expertise, experience, and real data.

Here the work is built on clear metrics and digital tools.

Here everything is achieved flexibly and quickly.


So why visual communication? Because it’s the key to the new strategy. Why? Because:

1. Modern people read little. They scan.
2. Visual format allows them to quickly grasp complex things.
3. With animations, infographics, and videos, you can deliver the message in just 15 seconds.

Curious how this works in practice? The marketing agency of the future (video agency 2.0) helps achieve better results!

chapter3.title: AMM Agency for business – a way to change everything radically
chapter3.p2: The videos are unique. They work at every stage of the sales funnel (from first attraction to conversion). Messages about internal values, onboarding new colleagues, educational and training products are delivered clearly and simply.
chapter3.p4:
With it, it becomes clear who and what the video agency 2.0 works for. It’s made for those who want bold and clear positioning on the market, uniqueness of style, messaging, narratives, and design. And also for those who are just taking their first steps. Here, 'marketing jargon' is translated into the language modern business understands.

Original visual solutions are the key part of the strategy. All content is aimed at improving sales performance.

Brands are actively strengthened with quality PR videos, engaging stories, and other content. The right reputation is built. The right audience is attracted.
